title: Research: exclude character-controlled one-child idle-phase repair
body:
The T740 owner0/port0 idle-axis transfer `child10 -> child12, axis16` gives favorable residual ranks `48,48 -> 47,49`, but changes the physical operator. This package tests absorption into one existing phase child using reciprocal stream charts that may vary arbitrarily with each Fourier character, even granting arbitrary nonzero child eigenvalues and free added implementation costs.

All twenty sites fail at the combined character `33554448`. A conjugated single-stream phase has pointwise defect rank at most one; every required replacement has a nonzero two-by-two minor. At PR3254's previously exceptional receiver, the defect is `(i-1)(E00+E64+E66)`, with minor `-2i`. Its two separate samples each have rank one, so the combined character supplies the missing test beyond the fixed-chart obstruction.

`research/idle-character-controlled-absorption/` contains the proof, exact source-bound witnesses and two separately constructed checkers. Arbitrary entering stream dirt, exact global phase and arbitrary dirty restored spectators are included. The calculation retains the inherited eight-stream completed-child projection. Cross-character mixing, paid nonreciprocal adapters, joint rewrites, other transfers and physical supplier admission remain open. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Validation at `74d54090585e4b2c6d648be30f4ac0e8e4466c67`:

- Complete registered Python3.12 replay and both optimized Python3.14 checkers from a committed read-only Git-free export pass.
- All26 publication package/input files match the commit; all28 exported files, adding selected/catalogue provenance, verify.
- Independent141-operation arithmetic checks80 replacement completions,80 unchanged literal children and every decisive matrix/minor. Translation, source-sign and inverse-order controls reject; disabled-check variants establish sensitivity.
- Every declared Git dependency resolves from canonical ancestry. The initial hosted replay exposed two unavailable sibling-PR provenance objects. Their exact hashes and credit are now retained as explicitly scoped predecessor citations, rather than runtime Git dependencies. Runtime inputs, verification commands, mathematical code and witness values are unchanged. The citation bytes were checked locally during construction; generic hosted replay does not fetch or reverify them.

Credit PR3254, PR3220, PR3229's distinct sharing premise, Gonzalo-Mier/PR3199, Nick Petalas/PR3187, Gareth Davidson/PR1387, Jeremy Diviney/PR3148, Rohan Arun, Arham Tahir's adjacent reciprocal-basis result, dcharb78, Marius-Paul Dumitrean, Jeremy Kothe and the retained native/geometry lineage. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separately tasked mathematical verification; no independent human or formal-kernel review. New material Apache-2.0; frozen sources unchanged.
